intuition: An arrow placed at the earliest ending point of an overlap can burst every balloon in that overlap.

brute_force.approach: Try arrow positions at balloon endpoints and count how many balloons each position can burst.

optimal.approach: Sort intervals by end coordinate and shoot a new arrow only when the next interval starts after the current arrow.

edge_cases: Touching endpoints belong to the same intersection.
A single balloon needs one arrow.
An empty interval list needs no arrows.
